caption: The drawing features two silver spoons positioned horizontally in the center of a light beige background, one above the other, with their bowls facing left. The upper spoon is plain with an engraved shell design at the base of the bowl, a simple handle, multiple hallmarks, the year “1812,” and a rounded end. The lower spoon also has a shell design at the base of the bowl and on the handle’s end, which is further decorated with scrollwork and a monogram. Both spoons are rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with shading to indicate their metallic quality and reflective surfaces. The artist’s signature “WALT. CONK.” appears in the bottom left corner. There is a light brownish discoloration in the upper right corner and slight aging around the paper's edges.
title: Silver Spoon
